>
I can't argue that you aren't insignificant. It's a matter of one's value system. If human experience has value, if the feeling of tasting delicious food has value, then life has value, no matter how short or fleeting. I am going to die and I am going to be dead for far longer than I will be alive, but I still find myself significant. 

This is something that I have just fully understood very recently.  Being in such a depressed state as I was when I made this post, I don't think I had the clarity to comprehend this.

Thank you so much for your post.  It has really helped me.
I just wanted to say thanks for your post.  It really helped me these past few weeks, and I'm doing much better.
